otp.title: Verification Code

otp.toast_session_unavailable: This verification session is no longer available. Request a new code.
otp.toast_timed_out: Verification timed out. Check the network and try again.
otp.toast_resend_timeout: Resend request timed out. Check the network and try again.
otp.toast_new_code: A fresh code is ready. Enter it to continue.
